newsitem.title: USA: YBM Magnex denies patent infringement claim.
newsitem.headline: YBM Magnex denies patent infringement claim.

text.p: The president of YBM Magnex International Inc late Monday denied claims of patent infringement contained in a lawsuit filed against the company by Magnequench International Inc.

"We produce a completely different product (from Magnequench)," Jacob Bogatin, president of YBM Magnex, told Reuters. "There are four elements in the magnets we make, while there are three (elements) in their magnets."
Bogatin, who said he had not seen a copy of the lawsuit filed earlier Monday, said the magnets YGM Magnex produces are covered by two patents the company received last year.
In a prepared statement, Magnequench said its suit followed reports of the sale of an unlicensed form of its Neodymium-Iron-Boron magnetic material in the United States.
"We don't need a license since our patents cover our products," Bogatin said.
